odvs.description: win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality is the policy setting determines the level of data encryption that is requested on behalf of clients that issue LDAP BIND requests. Configuring this setting to Require signing also conforms to the benchmark. The recommended state for this setting is: Negotiate signing. Note: Possible Valid Settings 1 - Negotiate signing 2 - Require signing
odvs.name: ldap_client_confidentiality

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.11.8 | PATCH | Ensure 'Network security: LDAP client encryption requirements' is set to 'Negotiate sealing' or higher"
  when: win25cis_rule_2_3_11_8
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - level1-memberserver
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.11.8
    - patch
    - ldap
    - NIST800-171_3.1.13
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-171_3.13.8
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-17_2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-8
    - NIST800-53R5_SC-8_1
  block:
    - name: "2.3.11.8 | PATCH | Ensure 'Network security: LDAP client encryption requirements' is set to 'Negotiate sealing' or higher | Apply Variable To Registry"
      when:
        - win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality == 1 or
          win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality == 2
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Ldap
        name: LDAPClientConfidentiality
        data: "{{ win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "2.3.11.8 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Network security: LDAP client encryption requirements' is set to 'Negotiate sealing' or higher | Warning Check For Variable"
      when:
        - win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality == 0 or
          win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality > 2
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid variable set for win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.11.8 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Network security: LDAP client encryption requirements' is set to 'Negotiate sealing' or higher | Warn Count"
      when:
        - win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality == 0 or
          win25cis_ldap_client_confidentiality > 2
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.11.8'
